Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU SURG GENTAMICIN WEIGHT BASED DOSING
ERUC: ORZID GMENU ER/UC SURG GENTAMICIN SPECIFIC DOSING
Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Recommended Gentamicin Preop Dose based on patient weight:

Preop dose administer over 30mins beginning 60 minutes before incision:

### Weight < 50 kg:

Gentamicin 240 mg IV ONCE

### Weight >/= 50 kg and < 75 kg:

Gentamicin 300 mg IV ONCE

### Weight >/= 75 kg and < 100 kg:

Gentamicin 400 mg IV ONCE

### Weight >/= 100 kg and < 120 kg:

Gentamicin 500 mg IV ONCE

### Weight >/= 120 kg:

Gentamicin 600 mg IV ONCE

## ER/UC

### Recommended Gentamicin Doses based on patient weight:

### Weight equal/less 50kg:

Gentamicin 240 mg IV beginning 60 minutes before incision

### Weight greater 50 kg and less 75 kg

Gentamicin 300 mg IV beginning 60 minutes before incision

### Weight equal 75 kg and less than 100kg:

Gentamicin 400 mg beginning 60 minutes before incision

### Weight equal to 100 kg and less than 120kg:

Gentamin 500 mg beginning 60 minutes before incision

### Weight equal/greater 120 kg:

Gentamicin 600 mg IV beginning 60 minutes before incision
